title: Renovation Cost Estimate — €5/m² | DUMSKAYA DESIGN
description: Detailed renovation cost estimate for an apartment or house: works, materials, furniture and appliances. €5/m² of floor area. Bratislava and Vienna.
h1: Renovation cost estimates for apartments and houses in Bratislava and Vienna

blocks.text: Renovation cost estimates for apartments and houses in Bratislava and Vienna

parts.html: We prepare detailed renovation cost estimates for apartments, private houses, and commercial spaces in Bratislava and Vienna: what work is needed, how much of it, what it costs, and how much material it will take. An estimate is ordered before renovation starts, so you know the budget, can compare contractors’ quotes, and can plan purchases. The cost is €5/m² of the property’s floor area.

We calculate from the actual dimensions and condition of the rooms, not from an average price per square meter. The estimate is based on an interior design project with working drawings, if there is one, or on a scope of work we agree with you on site.

We visit the property, measure the walls, floors, and ceilings, and check how far the surfaces are out of true. A wall that has to be leveled with plaster and a straight wall ready for paint look different in an estimate, just as a floor that needs screed differs from one with a finished base. We calculate quantities of work and materials from the measurements, so the estimate stays closer to the actual costs.

items: work items with quantities and costs — preparation and demolition, construction, electrical, plumbing, and finishing, depending on the property;
a specification of construction and finishing materials: what is needed, in what quantity, and roughly what it costs;
if you wish — furniture, appliances, plumbing fixtures, and lighting, so you can see the full budget for the apartment or house.

parts.html: Work and materials are broken down by section. You can see what the budget is made up of, and every line item can be compared with another contractor’s quote. If the materials or scope of work change, we adjust the estimate.

items: Inquiry. You send us a floor plan, photos of the rooms, and, if you have them, an interior design project or drawings. The consultation is free, and we reply within one business day.
Measurements. We visit the property in Bratislava or Vienna and check the condition of the surfaces.
Scope of work. We agree on what is to be done: which partitions come down and which go up, how many electrical and plumbing points, what goes on the floors and walls.
Calculation. We work out the quantities and the cost of labor and materials.
Handover of the estimate. We go through it with you section by section and answer your questions.

parts.html: A cost estimate costs €5/m² of the property’s floor area. If you then hire us for the renovation, the cost of the estimate is deducted from the price of the work.
Example: for a 60 m² apartment, the estimate is €300. If our crews then renovate this apartment, the €300 is deducted from the price of the work. A 140 m² private house — €700.

The estimate is based on the available information about the property and the agreed scope of work. Final costs may change if hidden defects are found during renovation, or if design decisions, the scope of work, or material prices change.

If the renovation affects the common parts of the building — load-bearing or exterior walls, shared building services, the facade — we clarify this before the calculation. In Slovakia, an apartment owner may not make alterations that change the building’s appearance or unreasonably disturb the neighbors without the consent of the other owners, and the building manager (správca) has the right to check whether the work affects the common parts. In Vienna, for an owner-occupied apartment (Wohnungseigentum), such work also requires the consent of the other owners, and the property management company (Hausverwaltung) cannot give it on their behalf. Whether this work goes into the estimate depends on that approval.
For more on the work our crews do, see the turnkey renovation page.

items.q: Can I order an estimate without an interior design project?
items.a: Yes. We calculate from the measurements and a scope of work agreed with you. With working drawings — for example, from the “Basic” package — the estimate is more accurate, since the tile layout, electrical and plumbing points, and materials are already defined. Without drawings, we price some items based on preliminary decisions and refine them once the decisions are made.

items.q: Can I give your estimate to another contractor?
items.a: Yes, the estimate is yours to keep. When several contractors price the same scope of work with the same quantities, you can see the price difference on every line item.

items.q: Do you include custom furniture in the estimate?
items.a: Yes, if the project needs it: kitchens, wardrobes, walk-in closets. We make the furniture at our own production facility in Bratislava, and delivery is included in its price, so the estimate shows the total with delivery and installation right away.

items.q: Does an estimate for a property in Vienna cost more?
items.a: No, it is the same €5/m². We take the measurements on site, and the trip to Vienna is not charged separately — it is about an hour’s drive from Bratislava. For an 80 m² apartment, the estimate costs €400, whether in Vienna or Bratislava.

items.q: When is the best time to order an estimate?
items.a: When the working drawings are ready, or at least the scope of work is clear. In a new build — after the apartment handover inspection: defects the developer has to fix under the handover report do not need to be included in the renovation budget.
